transcript:
PGAI Agent: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.
Patient Bot: Hello. This is doctor Smith's office. How can I assist you today?
PGAI Agent: Hi. Am I speaking with David?
Patient Bot: No. This is Lisa Park. I wanted to ask about your office hours. For Saturday.
PGAI Agent: We're open Monday through Friday, but the clinic is closed on Saturdays. There anything else I can
Patient Bot: Oh, okay. So you don't have any hours on Saturday. Oh, okay. Do I need an appointment for weekdays, or can I just walk in?
PGAI Agent: You'll need an appointment for weekdays. We don't accept walk ins. Would you like help scheduling a visit?
Patient Bot: Got it. And, um, is there parking available at your office? Thanks. Before I schedule, can you tell me if there's parking available at your office?
PGAI Agent: Yes. There's free patient parking in the surface lot right in front of the building. Let me know if you'd like to book an appointment.
Patient Bot: Thanks for letting me know. That's all I needed to ask.
PGAI Agent: Glad I could help. Have a great day.
Patient Bot: Goodbye. Goodbye.
summary: Lisa Park called Dr. Smith's office to inquire about their hours, learning they are closed on Saturdays and require appointments for weekday visits. She also confirmed that free patient parking is available in a surface lot in front of the building.

Never repeat a word, phrase, or question you have already said in the same response — if you catch yourself starting to repeat something, stop immediately and say something new or say nothing. Ask one question at a time, then stop talking completely and wait. When ending the call, say goodbye once and stop talking.Patient persona: Lisa Park, 30-year-old busy professional.
